policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV renders a plural verb, "They shall not make baldness upon their head," parallel to the plural "neither shall they shave" and "their beard" in the same verse. The qere yiqrechu is the plural imperfect that wording requires; the ketiv yqrchh, with final he for the plural waw, does not give the plural form the ASV translates. Wording, not a note: the ASV prints no textual note at 21:5.
